# Women's Health Duo

> Holistic women's healthcare by two sisters: Dr. Charmi Shah (OB-GYN — obstetrics, gynecology, IVF, laparoscopy) and Dr. Zalak Shah (women's health physiotherapist and STOTT Pilates instructor for **Mat** and **Reformer**, including **Mat Pilates online**). **Primary access for international patients is online** (video OB-GYN, online physio / Pilates programs). **In person:** Dr. Charmi in **Mumbai**, **Ahmedabad**, and **Valsad**; Dr. Zalak in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**—both offer **virtual** visits worldwide.
>
> **Entity line (brand ↔ doctors):** Women's Health Duo — Dr. Charmi Shah (OB-GYN / IVF) & Dr. Zalak Shah (women's health physio / STOTT Pilates). **Not a supplement or pill brand:** education + booked consults.

## Summary

- **Brand:** Women's Health Duo
- **India:** In-person visits for Dr. Charmi in **Mumbai**, **Ahmedabad**, and **Valsad**; for Dr. Zalak in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**; strong emphasis on **online** access for people anywhere.
- **Dr. Charmi Shah (OB-GYN):** Pregnancy and high-risk obstetrics, gynecology, IVF/IUI and fertility workup, laparoscopic surgery, PCOS, endometriosis, menopause, routine women's health — **online OB-GYN consults** available globally; in person in **Mumbai**, **Ahmedabad**, and **Valsad**.
- **Dr. Zalak Shah (physio & Pilates):** Women's health physiotherapy, pelvic floor, **prenatal and postnatal** rehab, musculoskeletal care for women, **Mat Pilates online**, **STOTT Pilates on Mat and Reformer**, wellness programs — **online classes and guidance** for international clients; in person in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**.
- **Delivery:** **Online-first worldwide** (video visits from India); many **city** overview pages plus **service-by-city** pages under `/online-consultation/...` (lists highlight common metros only—**many more cities worldwide** are welcome the same way). Dedicated India city pages (e.g. Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Valsad, Bengaluru) describe local access.

## Discovery & indexing (production)

- **Canonical site:** `https://womenshealthduo.com` (no trailing slash in env defaults).
- **Agent skills index:** [`/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`](https://womenshealthduo.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) — curated SKILL.md entries (site overview, booking, Learn hub) with SHA-256 digests; regenerated at `npm run build`.
- **Content discovery linkset:** [`/.well-known/content-catalog.json`](https://womenshealthduo.com/.well-known/content-catalog.json) — RFC 9264 `application/linkset+json` pointing to `llms.txt`, agent skills index, Learn articles, and sitemap (not an API catalog).
- **Robots:** [`/robots.txt`](https://womenshealthduo.com/robots.txt) — Cloudflare prepends `Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference` and **Disallow** for training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, …); origin rules **Allow** Googlebot, Bingbot, and agent-fetch bots (ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, anthropic-ai). Lists sitemap URLs.
- **Sitemap:** [`/sitemap.xml`](https://womenshealthduo.com/sitemap.xml) — at **`npm run build`**, a **single `<urlset>`** (not a sitemap index) lists the **primary** crawl set (core pages, Learn hub filters, **every Learn watch URL**, topic guides, virtual hub/country/city, international consultation, book teleconsultation, free community) with **`<lastmod>`**, **`<changefreq>`**, and **`<priority>`** (`sitemapPriorityForPath()` in `src/config/routes.ts`). Current primary urlset size is on the order of **950+ URLs** (includes **~195** `/learn/watch/…` clip pages). **`robots.txt`** also lists [`/sitemap-virtual-service-cities.xml`](https://womenshealthduo.com/sitemap-virtual-service-cities.xml) (long-tail **service × city** URLs) and [`/sitemap-videos.xml`](https://womenshealthduo.com/sitemap-videos.xml) (**Google Video sitemap** for YouTube Shorts + Instagram Reels watch pages: title, description, thumbnail, embed/player loc).
- **HTML head:** root [`index.html`](https://womenshealthduo.com/) receives build-time tokens for title, description, **meta keywords** (comma-separated topics for legacy crawlers), Open Graph, and a **`<link rel="sitemap">`** to the absolute sitemap URL.

## URL patterns (Learn hub — Shorts, Reels, posts & watch pages)

- **Hub (filtered carousel):** `/learn`, `/learn/dr-charmi`, `/learn/dr-zalak`, `/learn/topic/<topicSlug>`, `/learn/<doctorSegment>/topic/<topicSlug>` (topic slug from label, e.g. `fertility`, `labor-and-delivery`, `pilates`, `carousel`, `posts`).
- **Per-clip watch pages (Google Video / one `VideoObject` each):** `/learn/watch/<videoId>/` where `<videoId>` is `ig-…` (Instagram reel), `igp-…` (Instagram post or carousel), or a YouTube id for Shorts. **All hub rows** (~190+ clips: reels, carousels/feed posts, and YouTube Shorts) are in the primary sitemap; **reels + YouTube Shorts** additionally appear in **`sitemap-videos.xml`** with rich video metadata. Watch pages use descriptive poster **`alt`/`title`**, **`og:image`**, and schema **`ImageObject`** + **`VideoObject`** (or **`SocialMediaPosting`** for static Instagram posts).
- **Playback:** YouTube Shorts use the official embed. Instagram **reels** use a native `<video>` when a CDN `videoUrl` is available from import (licensed-music reels); otherwise the official `/reel/{id}/embed/` iframe. Instagram **posts/carousels** use the official `/p/{id}/embed/` iframe. Cover images for posters are stored on-site under **`/images/hub-thumbs/`** when import succeeds.
- **Articles index:** `/learn/articles` — written topic guides (flat paths like `/pcos`, `/endometriosis`, …).
- **Topical clusters (main `/learn` only):** `/learn#learn-pillars` — **six** Bing-oriented hubs (hormonal health, menstrual health, fertility & ovulation, pregnancy & labor, PCOS, STOTT Pilates) with links into topic filters and example virtual-care URLs.

## URL patterns (virtual SEO)

- **Hub:** `/online-consultation`
- **Country index:** `/online-consultation/country/<countrySlug>` (e.g. `india`, `united-states`)
- **City overview:** `/online-consultation/<citySlug>` (e.g. `dubai-ae`, `london`, `toronto`)
- **Service × city:** `/online-consultation/<citySlug>/<serviceSlug>` — one page per combination for long-tail discovery.
- **Legacy:** `/global-online` redirects to `/online-consultation` (preserve old bookmarks).

## Online service slugs (`<serviceSlug>`)

These repeat under every virtual city (see `src/data/seoOnlineServices.ts` in the repository): `pregnancy-high-risk-obstetrics`, `ivf-fertility-treatments`, `laparoscopic-surgery`, `pcos-hormonal-disorders`, `gynecological-care`, `menopause-wellness`, `pelvic-floor-rehabilitation`, `antenatal-postnatal-care`, `mat-pilates-online`, `stott-pilates`, `musculoskeletal-physiotherapy`, `core-functional-training`, `womens-wellness-programs`.

## Topics & queries this site is built for

- **OB-GYN / IVF (Dr. Charmi):** pregnancy & high-risk obstetrics, gynecology, IVF/IUI discussion, laparoscopy-related consults, PCOS/endometriosis, menopause, routine women's health — **telehealth from India** for NRIs and global families; **in person** in **Mumbai**, **Ahmedabad**, and **Valsad**.
- **Physio / Pilates (Dr. Zalak):** pelvic floor, **prenatal and postnatal** care, **Mat Pilates online**, STOTT **Mat & Reformer**, MSK physio, core/functional training, wellness-style programs — **online-first** worldwide; **in person** in **Bangalore** and **Ahmedabad**.
- **Languages often used on consults:** English, Hindi, Gujarati (request when you message).
- **Booking:** Structured teleconsultation at **`/book-consultation`** (patient details + mandatory telemedicine consent, then WhatsApp handoff). General questions: WhatsApp and email on the site; **not** emergency services. **Free education community** (public WhatsApp group, not clinical chat): **`/free-womens-health-community`**.

- **About:** [/about](https://womenshealthduo.com/about) or [/#about](https://womenshealthduo.com/#about)
- **Services:** [/services](https://womenshealthduo.com/services) or [/#services](https://womenshealthduo.com/#services) — the first block is a **quick topic map** ([/pillars](https://womenshealthduo.com/pillars) or `#pillars`), then the full doctor-by-doctor service list.
- **Testimonials:** [/testimonials](https://womenshealthduo.com/testimonials) or [/#testimonials](https://womenshealthduo.com/#testimonials)
- **Contact:** [/contact](https://womenshealthduo.com/contact) or [/#contact](https://womenshealthduo.com/#contact)
- **FAQ preview (homepage accordion):** [/quick-answers](https://womenshealthduo.com/quick-answers) or [/#faq](https://womenshealthduo.com/#faq) — distinct from the full FAQ page at `/faq`.

## Note for site owners

If the live domain differs, update `VITE_SITE_URL` in `.env`, `src/config/site.defaults.ts` (`SITE_DEFAULT_URL`), and this file so links stay accurate. Marketing URLs live in `src/config/routes.ts`, `src/lib/virtualConsultation.ts`, `src/data/seoOnlineServices.ts`, and `src/data/virtualConsultationCities.json`; Learn clip data in `src/data/knowledgeHubInstagramReels.json`, `knowledgeHubInstagramPosts.json`, and `knowledgeHubVideos.ts`; hub cover images in `public/images/hub-thumbs/` (refresh via `npm run import:instagram` or `npm run retry:hub-thumbnails`). **`dist/sitemap.xml`** (primary) and **`dist/sitemap-virtual-service-cities.xml`** (service×city only) are written at build time. Legacy `/global-online` URLs redirect to `/online-consultation`.
